answer_verbatim:
For a **small business**, the best *single* service to start with is usually a **free baseline checker** like **HubSpot AI Search Grader**, because it tells you whether ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini mention your business at no cost.[1] If you want the strongest **ongoing tracking** after that, **Otterly.AI** is one of the cheapest serious options at about **$29/month**, while **AI Rank Checker** is a pay-as-you-go alternative that tracks multiple AI engines.[2][13]

A practical way to choose is:

- **Free first check:** **HubSpot AI Search Grader** for a quick snapshot across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini.[1]
- **Lowest-cost ongoing monitoring:** **Otterly.AI** if you want regular tracking on a small budget.[13]
- **Broader multi-engine coverage:** **AI Rank Checker** if you want checks across more AI platforms and prefer pay-per-use pricing.[2]
- **Best “tell me what to fix” option:** **AI Search Brand Report / AIScope** or similar report-style tools if you want recommendations, not just a score.[3]

If your question is specifically “**which service is best to check whether ChatGPT recommends my business?**” then a **free baseline tool first** is the smartest start, and **HubSpot AI Search Grader** is the clearest entry point from the results you provided.[1] If you need to monitor it over time, pick a dedicated tracker like **Otterly.AI** or **AI Rank Checker** depending on whether you prefer subscription pricing or pay-per-check pricing.[2][13]
